text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Long-standing soba shops really are on another level when it comes to the broth and side dishes!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And what's more, there's usually a massive line, but I just happened to get in without having to wait at all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Great luck, and great taste!
Really puts you in a booming, upbeat mood.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I bought some soba manju as a souvenir, too!
Let's dig in with some pipin' hot tea!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Inari One fully enjoyed her day off.
